formative_worksheets.title: The Ruler and Time Check
formative_worksheets.when_to_use: After Lesson 3, before Lesson 4. Quick mid-unit check (10 min).
formative_worksheets.purpose: Standalone formative check confirming ruler use and cm/m before time.
formative_worksheets.student_learning_goal: I can use a ruler and convert cm/m.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can use a ruler and convert cm/m.
header.character_watermark: Roo with a clipboard in the top-right. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

image_placeholders.description: A 7-cm horizontal line for Grade 2 formative check, B&W line art. Below: '___ cm' answer line.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q1_LINE: instructions ask the child to measure in cm. Keywords name the visual and unit.

prompts.visual_layout: Two conversion problems with answer lines.

image_placeholders.description: Two conversion problems for Grade 2 formative check. '100 cm = ___ m' and '2 m = ___ cm' with answer lines.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q2_CONVERT: instructions ask the child to convert cm and m. Keywords name the activity.

prompts.prompt: How are you feeling? Circle the face.

image_placeholders.description: Three round face icons for Grade 2 formative check.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q3_FACES at Prompt 3: keywords name the visual.

formative_worksheets.teacher_notes: Administer between Lesson 3 and Lesson 4. Print one per child.

reflection_sheet.title: My Measure Maven Reflection
reflection_sheet.student_learning_goal: I can think about what I learned this week.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can think about what I learned this week.
header.character_watermark: Roo and Cal with a Junior Measure Maven certificate in the top-right. References blueprint.recurring_characters.

prompts.prompt: How do you feel? Circle one.

image_placeholders.description: Three rating ovals for Grade 2 reflection.

image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: REF_YN_TABLE at Prompt 2: keywords name the response options.
